Yes, that’s the right order. The reason is “no longer needed.” Please go ahead and cancel it.
Thanks. I also want to cancel the boot and the kettle from my orders. Can you help with that?
Please list my remaining orders so I can tell you which ones to cancel.
I want to cancel both the boot and the kettle from that order. The reason is “no longer needed.” Please cancel just those two items.

Thanks. One more thing—I want to return the sneaker I bought. Can you help me with that?
Yes, please list my delivered orders so I can pick the right one.
Yes, that’s the one. Please process the return for the sneaker and refund it to my gift card.
That’s all for now. Thanks for your help. ###STOP###
